in_sanskrit.name: सुकन्या
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: The name Sukanya is derived from the Sanskrit word सुक (suk), which means 'good', 'happiness', or 'prosperity'. The suffix न्या (anya) means 'belonging to' or 'possessing'. Thus, Sukanya means 'possessing goodness, prosperity, or happiness'.

in_hindi.name: सुकन्या
in_hindi.long_meaning: The name Sukanya is derived from the Hindi words सुख (suk), which means 'happiness' or 'pleasure', and न्या (anya), which means 'belonging to' or 'possessing'. Thus, Sukanya means 'possessing happiness or pleasure'.

in_tamil.name: ஸுகன்யா
in_tamil.long_meaning: The name Sukanya is derived from the Tamil words காலையல் (kālaiyāl), which means 'goodness', and னாய் (nāy), which means 'mother' or 'possessing'. Thus, Sukanya means 'possessing goodness as a mother' or 'mother of goodness'.

in_telugu.name: సుకన్యా
in_telugu.long_meaning: The name Sukanya is derived from the Telugu words శుభ (śubha), which means 'auspicious' or 'blissful', and న్యా (nī), which means 'belonging to' or 'possessing'. Thus, Sukanya means 'possessing auspiciousness or blissfulness'.

in_marathi.name: Sukanya
in_marathi.long_meaning: Sukanya हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। One who is good, pure, happy, fortunate and blessed.

in_bengali.name: Sukanya
in_bengali.meaning: হিন্দু নাম যার অর্থ Good, Happy
in_bengali.long_meaning: Sukanya একটি হিন্দু নাম যা ভারতীয় সংস্কৃতিতে গভীর আধ্যাত্মিক তাৎপর্য রাখে। One who is good, pure, happy, fortunate and blessed.

vedic_reference.note: The name Sukanya is derived from the Sanskrit word सुक (suk), which is used extensively in the Vedas to denote happiness, prosperity, and well-being. The name is also associated with the goddess Saraswati, who is the embodiment of knowledge, learning, and wisdom.
